findings.title: Git branching and commit standards
findings.evidence: pipeline.yml configures disallowed trigger branches including my-analysis-branch and hotfix.  Quoted: '- my-analysis-branch'
findings.reasoning: The pipeline configuration includes branch names that are not master, develop, or user-story/<number>. In particular, hotfix and my-analysis-branch are outside the allowed set.

remediation.description: Remove the disallowed trigger branches from pipeline.yml so the pipeline no longer includes my-analysis-branch or hotfix.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('pipeline.yml')
text = p.read_text()
text = text.replace("- my-analysis-branch\n", "")
text = text.replace("- hotfix\n", "")
p.write_text(text)
PY
